description: Price history of one model: every offer tracked by InferIndex (daily or weekly min/max/last price in USD, or raw price changes), plus the official price of the model's lab over time. Give either days, or from/to (YYYY-MM-DD), or at (a date) for the prices in effect that day.

at.description: A single date, YYYY-MM-DD: prices in effect that day

days.description: Number of days back from today (default 7)

from.description: Start date, YYYY-MM-DD (with to, instead of days)

granularity.description: day (default), week, or raw price changes

model.description: Model id or name, e.g. 'deepseek-v3.2', 'deepseek/deepseek-v4-pro', 'gpt-5.6-luna'. Use search_models when unsure.

name: price_history
title: Price history of a model
